entries.name: arbitrary_precision_integer
entries.guard: big-integer representation, fuel, memory bound, canonical serialization required

entries.name: deterministic_hash_map_user_hasher
entries.guard: fixed hasher does not establish iteration order; require sorted map or canonical key order

entries.name: sequential_consistency_atomics
entries.guard: seq_cst constrains memory order but does not fix scheduler/interleaving

entries.name: fixed_precision_decimal
entries.guard: precision, scale, rounding, overflow, and culture-independent serialization required

entries.name: cooperative_coroutine
entries.guard: resume sequence must be explicit input; real-time scheduling excluded

entries.name: proper_tail_call
entries.guard: tail position and finite resource limits must be explicit

entries.name: stable_c_abi_layout
entries.guard: target ABI, width, endian, padding, and unsafe boundary must be specified

entries.name: abstract_data_type_hidden_invariant
entries.guard: module/type checker must prevent constructor escape

entries.name: software_transactional_memory
entries.guard: serializability does not fix commit order; sleep and scheduler are non-deterministic
